narrative.text: Presents the front cover and title page for the July 2022 update of the WHO document Monitoring Metrics Related to the Global Covid-19 Vaccination Strategy in a Changing World.
Displays the inner title page for the July 2022 update of Monitoring Metrics Related to the Global Covid-19 Vaccination Strategy in a Changing World.

States the document's purpose as specifying monitoring metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs, metrics 1–3 and 7) to guide progress toward the July 2022 WHO Global Covid-19 Vaccination Strategy, and presents the first part of Table 1 covering country-level metrics 1–6 under Goal 1 (reducing mortality and morbidity, protecting health systems, and resuming socio-economic activity with existing vaccines, including primary-series and booster coverage for healthcare workers, older adults, total populations, and humanitarian settings, adult vaccination systems, and electronic health information reporting).

Completes Table 1 with global-level metrics 7–10 under Goal 2 (accelerating development and access to improved vaccines, covering clinical-trial and authorized products, effectiveness and safety studies against variants of concern, and secured and delivered doses per 100 inhabitants by income group), outlines monthly and annual WHO reporting mechanisms, and begins Table 2 with metadata and ILOStat/WHO workforce sources for Metric 1.

Continues Table 2 with metadata indicators and data sources for Metrics 2 through 6, detailing regional country reports, UN population estimates, OCHA Global Humanitarian Overview and UN Global Health Cluster data for humanitarian settings, planned data-collection mechanisms for adult vaccination systems, and the WHO/UNICEF electronic Joint Reporting Form (eJRF) proxy question on electronic immunization systems.

Concludes Table 2 by specifying the metadata and data sources for Metrics 7, 8, and 9–10, including the WHO International Clinical Trials Registry Platform, public registries such as IVAC View-hub, the UNICEF COVID-19 Vaccine Market Dashboard, World Bank income classifications, and UN population estimates.
Presents the back page header for the July 2022 update of Monitoring Metrics Related to the Global Covid-19 Vaccination Strategy in a Changing World.
